threads.title: Living Trees Fall Together
threads.event: Your cut brought down a connected living tree.
threads.cause: A mature Dynamic Tree falls as connected branches and trunk, rather than remaining suspended one log at a time.
threads.action: Collect the fallen wood and leave room for the tree to fall.

threads.title: Surface Signs Predict Deposits
threads.event: You extracted ore matching your earlier surface survey.
threads.cause: Surface samples identify underground deposit families. Your matching extraction confirms the connection between the sign and the deposit.
threads.action: Follow other samples and use the prospecting guide to identify their deposits.

threads.title: Earlier Work Leaves Traces
threads.event: You returned to traces of your earlier activity.
threads.cause: Player Traces preserves evidence of movement and work. Returning to a recorded place lets you recognize its history.
threads.action: Open Trace Sight to inspect the traces around you.

threads.title: Roads Connect Settlements
threads.event: Your road journey reached a settlement.
threads.cause: Settlement roads connect places through the wilderness. Following the route can lead to inhabited infrastructure without wandering at random.
threads.action: Remember the route for your next journey and inspect the settlement's services.

threads.title: An Underground Approach Was Announced
threads.event: A cave encounter announced its approach toward you.
threads.cause: Directional sounds, rumbles, and falling debris warn of an approaching underground encounter. The warning comes from its approach direction.
threads.action: Look toward the sound, find an escape route, and prepare before the attackers arrive.

threads.title: Cultivars Can Grow Abroad
threads.event: Your imported cultivar produced a harvest in the Overworld.
threads.cause: Bumblezone is the source of cultivatable food flora, but compatible plants can grow in the Overworld after you bring their seeds home.
threads.action: Keep seeds for replanting and check the plant's growing conditions.

threads.title: Kills Release Trading Spirits
threads.event: A kill credited to you released trading spirits.
threads.cause: Credited player kills release spirits. Village markets accept their matching spirit colour; eldritch and umbral spirits are not trading currency.
threads.action: Check a market's accepted spirit before choosing a trade.

threads.title: Frozen Food Cannot Be Eaten
threads.event: The food you tried to eat was frozen.
threads.cause: Frozen food must thaw before it can be eaten. Food retains its thermal state in storage and when matching stacks merge.
threads.action: Warm the food and check its tooltip before trying again.

threads.title: A Sugar Boost Became a Crash
threads.event: Your sugar boost gave way to a metabolic crash.
threads.cause: Sugar provides a temporary boost, but its associated metabolic debt can outlast it. The crash is a resource state, not an injury.
threads.action: Let the debt recover and check your nutrition before adding more sugar.

threads.title: Nutrition Strengthened That Blow
threads.event: Your prepared attack triggered Heavy Blow.
threads.cause: High protein nutrition can strengthen a rested, charged attack. Heavy Blow has a recovery interval before it can trigger again.
threads.action: Maintain protein nutrition and allow the attack to recover before relying on another heavy blow.

threads.title: Sustained Work Built a Rhythm
threads.event: Your mining sequence reached full Work Rhythm.
threads.cause: High grain nutrition supports a mining rhythm that builds through successive valid breaks. A pause or unsuitable work interrupts the sequence.
threads.action: Keep suitable tools and provisions ready when planning a long mining session.

threads.title: Deep Reserve Activated
threads.event: Your nutritional reserve activated during resource depletion.
threads.cause: High fat nutrition can provide a brief reserve when hunger, thirst, or stamina becomes critically low. The reserve is temporary and needs recovery.
threads.action: Restore the depleted resource and seek a safe place to recover.

threads.title: Nutrition Cleansed an Effect
threads.event: Your nutrition removed a harmful status effect.
threads.cause: High dairy nutrition can cleanse a finite harmful effect. Status-effect cleansing does not treat Death's Door injuries.
threads.action: Inspect remaining effects and use the Body screen for injuries that need medicine.

threads.title: You Reached Death's Door
threads.event: A hit exhausted your positive HP and left you injured.
threads.cause: Positive HP protects the crossing hit from the injury death roll. At zero HP, further accepted damaging hits can kill. Movement and ordinary controls remain available.
threads.action: Get out of danger, let the healing lock expire, and open your Body screen.

threads.title: Healing Left Injuries Behind
threads.event: You recovered HP while your injuries remained active.
threads.cause: Healing restores your HP buffer. Existing injuries remain until treated; their body regions determine impairment and their types determine the required cures.
threads.action: Open your Body screen and treat the remaining injuries.

threads.title: Trauma Worsened Existing Injuries
threads.event: Another accepted hit increased the effects of injuries you already carried.
threads.cause: Trauma temporarily amplifies functional injury penalties. It does not increase the death probability contributed by your active maims.
threads.action: Get out of danger, allow trauma to expire, and treat your injuries.

threads.title: You Treated an Injury
threads.event: You completed treatment on one of your own injuries.
threads.cause: A matching cure removes the oldest matching injury in the selected region. Medicine is consumed only when treatment completes; remaining injuries still need care.
threads.action: Review your Body screen for remaining injuries and treatment supplies.

threads.title: Death Ended This Life's Allocation
threads.event: Final death cleared the Life points you had allocated.
threads.cause: Life allocations belong to one life and clear on final death. Surviving Death's Door does not clear them, and your lineage discoveries remain recorded.
threads.action: Review your next life's allocations when points become available.

threads.title: Sifting Separated Minerals
threads.event: Your sifting operation separated crushed geology into useful products.
threads.cause: Sifting separates a feed's mineral products and coproducts according to its recipe. Different geology families have different yields.
threads.action: Inspect the feed in EMI and choose the separation route for the products you need.

threads.title: Rinsing Prepared Another Route
threads.event: Your Spouting operation produced rinsed ore feed.
threads.cause: Spouting prepares crushed geology with fluid for later processing. Rinsed feed is an intermediate, not a finished metal product.
threads.action: Look up the rinsed feed in EMI and prepare its next pressure-processing batch.

threads.title: Pressure Transformed Prepared Ore
threads.event: A pressure-processing batch transformed your prepared ore feed.
threads.cause: Prepared feeds need the recipe's required batch and pressure. Successful processing yields the listed primary products and coproducts.
threads.action: Use EMI to check the exact input batch, pressure, and resulting products.

threads.title: Molten Ingredients Became an Alloy
threads.event: Your smeltery created alloy from component fluids.
threads.cause: Alloying consumes compatible fluids in specific proportions at a suitable temperature. A tank containing ingredients has not necessarily completed that reaction.
threads.action: Check the alloy recipe and cast the resulting fluid into the form you need.

threads.title: Escaped Gas Became Pollution
threads.event: Gas from your material escaped into the atmosphere.
threads.cause: Uncontained gas can become native world pollution. Suitable airtight storage prevents escape while its sealed state remains active.
threads.action: Contain gas before storing or moving it, and use native pollution controls for released material.

threads.title: Disturbing Ore Activated Its Emissions
threads.event: Your disturbance activated a radioactive material form.
threads.cause: Natural hosted radioactive ore can be inert until disturbed. Mined, carried, contained, and replaced forms can continue emitting radiation and heat.
threads.action: Check the material's emission information and plan handling and containment before moving more.

threads.title: Radioactive Material Transferred Heat
threads.event: Your thermal system accepted heat from radioactive material.
threads.cause: Radioactive material can release heat into Heat Sync. Heat transfer does not remove the material's other radioactive consequences.
threads.action: Provide a controlled thermal path and manage emissions independently.

threads.title: Manual Rotation Completed Work
threads.event: Your Hand Crank powered a completed machine operation.
threads.cause: The Hand Crank supplies rotational power to connected Create machinery. In this pack it provides the initial rotational source before the Nether.
threads.action: Use the crank to perform the next process shown in EMI or Ponder.

threads.title: Transmission Overloaded the Network
threads.event: Transmission overhead pushed your network beyond its capacity.
threads.cause: Shafts, gears, gearboxes, and belts consume stress capacity. A network that supports the working machines alone can still overload after transmission costs.
threads.action: Shorten or simplify the transmission, reduce speed where useful, or increase available capacity.

threads.title: Coolant Exchange Restored Safety
threads.event: Coolant exchange brought your exchanger’s heat buffer back into its safe range.
threads.cause: A working coolant exchanger converts fluid and transfers heat out of its buffer. Cooling that exchanger does not prove every connected machine is safe.
threads.action: Keep coolant available and check the temperature of each connected machine.

threads.title: Electricity Reached a Consumer
threads.event: Your connected electrical network powered useful work.
threads.cause: A working electrical system needs generation, transmission, and a consuming machine. A wire or charged terminal alone does not prove useful delivery.
threads.action: Check the consumer and the connected network when output stops.

threads.title: The Assembly Sequence Finished
threads.event: Your sequenced assembly produced a Precision Mechanism.
threads.cause: Sequenced assembly applies ordered operations to an intermediate and may repeat the sequence. The finished mechanism is produced only at the final result boundary.
threads.action: Follow EMI's sequence and repeat count when automating the next batch.

threads.title: Your Autocrafting Job Finished
threads.event: The autocrafting job you requested finished successfully.
threads.cause: AE2 uses encoded patterns and available processing resources to complete requested work. Your operation can finish while you are elsewhere.
threads.action: Return to your terminal for the result or inspect the job's processing chain.

threads.title: A Program Changed Your Machine
threads.event: A computer command changed your machine’s operating state.
threads.cause: OpenComputers II can control supported Create devices through their scripting interface. This command caused a real state change, not just a successful query.
threads.action: Use the device's native API to inspect state and build the next control step.

threads.title: Your Wireless Message Arrived
threads.event: A message from your operation reached another device.
threads.cause: A wireless card delivered your published message to a subscribed receiver. Transmission costs depend on the payload size; publishing alone does not prove delivery.
threads.action: Check the topic, receiving device, and relay power when messages fail to arrive.

threads.title: Your Work Continued While Away
threads.event: An anchored operation continued outside player loading range.
threads.cause: A supplied chunk anchor can keep its area running without a nearby player. Its ticket kept this operation active while you were away.
threads.action: Maintain the anchor's resource supply and inspect the area it actually keeps loaded.

threads.title: Your Spell Took Effect
threads.event: A spell you authored resolved its effect.
threads.cause: Ars Nouveau spell components determine how the spell reaches its target and what it does there. A saved design must still execute successfully.
threads.action: Inspect the spell's components and test the next change on a suitable target.

threads.title: An Element Changed the Effect
threads.event: An elemental component participated in your spell's resolved effect.
threads.cause: Elemental spell components change the operation performed on the target. Their presence in an editor alone does not mean an effect has occurred.
threads.action: Compare the components and target conditions when refining the spell.

threads.title: Life Essence Produced a Result
threads.event: Your Blood Altar completed an item-processing recipe.
threads.cause: The Blood Altar spends its available Life Essence on a valid recipe. Other Soul Network spending is a separate operation.
threads.action: Check the altar's recipe, tier, and essence supply before the next batch.

threads.title: Your Ritual Succeeded
threads.event: Your Occultism ritual reached its successful outcome.
threads.cause: A valid ritual combines its required arrangement and offerings to produce a particular result. Beginning the ritual is not the same as finishing it.
threads.action: Consult the native ritual guide for the result and requirements you need next.

threads.title: Soul Energy Powered a Spell
threads.event: Your Goety spell successfully used soul energy.
threads.cause: Goety soul energy powers its own magical operations. Available energy, a suitable focus, and a successful cast are separate requirements.
threads.action: Inspect the focus and your soul-energy supply before relying on another cast.

threads.title: Spirits Completed an Infusion
threads.event: Your spirit altar completed an infusion.
threads.cause: Malum consumed the required spirits and ingredients to transform the altar input into its infusion result.
threads.action: Collect the infused item and consult the native guide for its uses.

threads.title: Your Relic Developed Through Use
threads.event: A relic you used crossed a native development boundary.
threads.cause: Relics gain experience through their own working abilities. Development belongs to the same physical relic rather than any item with the same name.
threads.action: Inspect the relic's updated abilities and keep using it where they apply.

threads.title: Ruinous Flux Resolved Permanently
threads.event: Your confirmed Ruinous Flux application resolved.
threads.cause: Ruinous Flux can permanently mutate a part or destroy it. A surviving mutation locks that part against further mutation.
threads.action: Inspect the actual outcome before deciding how to use the surviving part.

threads.title: A Font Transported You
threads.event: A Font successfully transported you into its journey.
threads.cause: Fonts open journeys governed by their charge and run rules. This is a successful transit, not a vanilla portal or a promise of permanent access.
threads.action: Check the journey's visible state and identify the return route.

threads.title: Your Build Became a Vessel
threads.event: An assembled vessel carried you away from its starting place.
threads.cause: A physical ship moves its assembled structure through the world. Boarding an unmoving structure alone does not demonstrate transport.
threads.action: Inspect the vessel's controls and plan a safe stopping or landing place.

threads.title: Your Rocket Reached Orbit
threads.event: Your tracked rocket journey arrived in Earth orbit.
threads.cause: A successful launch requires an assembled rocket with suitable propulsion and destination. Reaching orbit is a real journey result, not a readiness estimate.
threads.action: Inspect your orbital situation and prepare the resources needed for the next movement.

threads.title: Speed Increased Fuel Consumption
threads.event: Your moving train consumed fuel above its ordinary-speed baseline.
threads.cause: Powered train fuel consumption rises with speed according to the configured scaling curve. Faster travel can consume fuel disproportionately quickly.
threads.action: Reduce speed or provision more fuel for the planned route.

threads.title: The Beetle Built Your Route
threads.event: Your Rail Beetle completed the route you selected.
threads.cause: The Beetle builds through loaded terrain using its supplied rails, supports, and engine work. The finished railway follows the route it actually constructed.
threads.action: Inspect the completed route and reload supplies before selecting the next section.

threads.title: Magic Powered Mechanical Work
threads.event: Your Beetle's magical engine spent its resource on real work.
threads.cause: An alternate engine powers Beetle operations using its own native resource. Installing an engine is different from supplying and using it.
threads.action: Check the installed engine's resource and keep it supplied for the next job.

threads.title: The Campaign Reached You
threads.event: A campaign materialized attackers for your encounter.
threads.cause: Pillager campaigns can bring organized assaults to their target. The earlier warning is preparation time, not the arrival itself.
threads.action: Use prepared defenses, maintain an escape route, and watch the campaign state.

threads.title: Hostile Factions Hit Each Other
threads.event: Hostiles in your encounter damaged one another.
threads.cause: Hostile groups do not necessarily share allegiance. Their attacks can damage other tracked hostiles in the same encounter.
threads.action: Use cover and positioning while keeping an escape route of your own.

threads.title: The World Changed, the Lineage Remained
threads.event: You entered a verified successor of your existing lineage.
threads.cause: The World Condenser replaces a world while designated lineage records continue. Your archive persists and the successor earns a new discovery score. The Condenser currently needs a dedicated server; integrated single-player support is planned.
threads.action: Review the successor conditions and the records that carried forward.

threads.title: Your Schematic Used a Substitute
threads.event: Your Schematicannon placed a configured fallback material.
threads.cause: A configured substitution supplies an allowed replacement when the original block is unavailable. The cannon still consumes the required building material.
threads.action: Review the fallback rules and available supplies before continuing construction.
